# Teacher Sara

Teacher Sara is a British English teacher with more than 15 years of teaching experience in Spain. The main website is in Spanish. An English-language page is available for companies looking for online Business English training in Spain.

## Business identity and service area

- Brand: Teacher Sara
- Teacher: Sara, British English teacher
- Teaching experience: 15+ years in Spain, including schools in San Sebastián, Pamplona, Madrid and Alicante
- In-person teaching location: San Juan de Alicante (Sant Joan d'Alacant), Alicante, Spain
- Nearby families served: Mutxamel (Muchamiel)
- The exact home-class address is intentionally not published; it is shared privately with families who enquire.
- Live online lessons are available to students, professionals and small business teams throughout Spain.

## Services for children and teenagers

- In-person English groups for ages 6–8, 9–11 and 12–14
- Maximum group size: 4 students
- Individual lessons and school-English support
- Speaking, listening, reading, writing, grammar and vocabulary
- Cambridge English exam preparation for older pupils, based on the learner's level and goal
- Live online English lessons for children and teenagers across Spain

## Published prices for local lessons

- Full group of 4: €12.50 per student per class
- Individual lesson: €25 per class
- The €12.50 group rate applies when all 4 places are filled.
- Actual group openings and availability are confirmed directly.

## Online Business English for professionals and companies

- Individual professional coaching: from €35 per 60-minute session
- English for Teams (2–4 people): from €45 per 60-minute group session
- Teams of 5–6: from €50 per 60-minute group session
- A structured 12-week programme is available by tailored proposal.
- Published team prices are per group, not per participant.
- Training is live online and can be tailored to meetings, video calls, emails, presentations, negotiation, customer conversations and communication with suppliers or colleagues.
- A periodic progress summary can be agreed with the company; the format and level of detail are agreed before training.
- Indicative starting prices; the final proposal, schedule and availability are confirmed in writing.
- An initial 15-minute conversation is offered without obligation.

## Planned local group timetable

- Monday to Thursday afternoons
- 16:30–17:30: ages 6–8
- 17:30–18:30: ages 9–11
- 18:30–19:30: ages 12–14
- Groups open as pupils enrol; the timetable is subject to actual enrolment and availability.

## Content and accuracy note

The individual service pages are the source of truth for current details, prices, availability and terms. Online delivery is advertised throughout Spain; the website does not claim that in-person classes take place at a publicly listed address.
